crux: approach toward camera (depth term and depth-corrected rest pixel height), then rest height in px at frame 24 depth (388-390 vs 400)
fault_found: C3/C4 (DeepSeek half of the blend) assume constant depth although the rigid upper-body scale grows 1.07 by f42 and 1.16 by f79 (ground-contact rows agree): they omit dz ~0.098 m/frame and use an uncorrected 418-420 px height
lesson: When estimating a one-frame depth step from template scale, do not use the evaluated frame itself as the template: matching to a template biases neighbouring-frame scales the same way, inflating the backward step and shrinking the forward one; use templates from other frames and take the ratio.
